summary: #487: end-to-end route from actual existence to a necessarily underived ground. First tried composing NECESSARY-CONCRETE-FROM-ACTUAL-GROUNDED with NECESSARY-UNDERIVED-POSITIVE-LIFT. Rejected: that needs well-foundedness of support by all existing supporters, stronger than the restricted ActualGroundingWF, and lifting. Used instead: a direct step from the necessary root witness itself. Finding 1: rootness does not transfer. A necessary actual root can fail to be underived in three separate ways (rotating support, possible contingent support, abstract support), each with the earlier premises holding. Finding 2: the necessity clause of NecessaryPredecessorLifting is not used by this route; the weaker NecessarySupportIsPresent suffices, with a model of all five premises where lifting fails. Finding 3: restricted well-foundedness does not reach abstract supporters, so the route needs ActualSupportersConcrete, and without it an abstract cycle defeats the conclusion. Finding 4: under the premises every actual concretum descends from an underived root, which is the route's explanatory reach; but in one model of all five premises two such roots have no ancestry either way and a ground exists where its effect does not. So the premises give neither unity nor effect-entailment. Rejected reading: treating a root's absence of actual concrete grounds as absence of explanation. The rival labels (brute root, circular or endless support, world-varying support, abstract support) name models; no author's view is reported, and Pruss, Oppy and Craig witnesses listed on #487 remain unread. #553's reverse direction was already certified by NECESSARY-OR-NONNECESSARY-ROOT, so nothing was added for it. The connection to the root route is in ATTEMPT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-ROUTE-487's PR. Same-witness direct-esse audit(2026-10-31): the already-built core theorem UnderivedRootRoute.underivedOfNecessaryRoot accepts the supplied n,ActualRoot m w n and NecessaryAt m.ontic w n, plus existing NecessarySupportIsPresent and ActualSupportersConcrete, and returns UnderivedRootAt for that identical n. The NamedNecessarilyUnderived m.ontic m.grounds w n endpoint is the direct projection of actual presence, necessity and that no-existing-support conjunct. Thus the new eight-input DIRECT-ESSE-ROOT-UNIQUENESS endpoint can retain its same witness and actual uniqueness while adding exactly those two open interfaces, with no fresh WF, union-WF, actual-reflexivity, no-contingent-support or logical assumption. Named absence and NecessarySupportIsPresent both quantify over ALL admitted worlds, including inaccessible ones; accessibility-only support transport does not meet that type. ActualSupportersConcrete quantifies over arbitrary actual supporters, not just supplied esse causes. ExistingInActAt and EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround cover selected actual causal applications and do not establish either added interface. NecessaryConcreteUnderived.checks is a different reusable certificate that may choose a different necessary final witness and excludes only concrete supporters; it cannot directly supply this same-n unrestricted-support endpoint. Existing rotating/absent/abstract-support controls already record the scope gaps; no duplicate model or new proof artifact was added. Actual uniqueness remains at selected w, not uniqueness of every other world source; no all-world outgoing causal coverage or complete explanation follows. No premise independently defended or discharged, no frontier argument rewired. Follow-up proof-minimization audit(2026-10-31): exact underivedOfNecessaryRoot proof uses the two global interfaces only at its supplied target n. Needed locally are (i) any existing incoming supporter of n at any admitted v is present and supports n at actual w, and (ii) each actual existing incoming supporter of this actual concrete n is concrete. No derivation of those needed instances from DirectEsseRootRoute was found: ExistingInActAt constrains existence-to-esse only at w; EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround maps supplied esse causes to grounds at w in ONE direction. An arbitrary incoming grounds v y n supplies neither CausesIn y n esse nor grounds w y n nor source concreteness. maximumEqualsRoot identifies maximum candidates with n but does not make an arbitrary incoming supporter a maximum. necessaryRootCommonGround supplies outgoing grounds w n x for actual concrete x distinct from n, not transport of arbitrary incoming edges. Opposite support edges would additionally need an independently justified asymmetry premise before contradiction; none is supplied, and nonactual/nonconcrete supporters are outside that outgoing coverage. Freezing R to the actual graph or restricting its supporter domain to concreta would change the all-world unrestricted-support conclusion rather than prove it for the original m.grounds. Existing certified UnderivedRootRoute.rotatingSupport, possibleContingentSupport and abstractSupportControl, bundled by UNDERIVED-ROUTE-CONTROLS, establish the old root/transport/concreteness omission boundaries; their certificates do NOT list the complete new eight-input direct-esse bundle, so they are not advertised as a formal counterexample to that exact bundle. No existing exact-eight-input nonimplication certificate was found. No new model, modal-rigidity premise, relation definition, Lean theorem or duplicate packaging artifact was created; this remains a scoped absence of a derivation with precisely identified missing incoming-edge information, not an unproved blanket nonentailment theorem.
blocker: No defence for any real relation of the closing premise, restricted well-foundedness, present support or concrete supporters. No route premise consumes STMT-NECESSARILY-UNDERIVED, so the route does not lower a root cost. For the direct-esse same witness, independently justify all-world support transport back to actual w and actual concreteness of arbitrary existing supporters of that necessary actual concretum. Accessible-world transport alone is insufficient for NamedNecessarilyUnderived, whose absence ranges over all admitted worlds. The direct-esse common-source helpers constrain outgoing actual grounding and one-way cause-to-ground correspondence, not incoming support at other worlds. Even the target-local transport/concreteness instances used by the existing proof remain unestablished; existing negative certificates concern their earlier advertised bundles, not the exact new eight-input direct-esse bundle.
